resources.string: Use edge gestures to run actions or open panels. Touch areas receive touches even when hidden. Nudge does not read screen content.
Allow enabled handles to receive gestures.
Open Downloaded apps. Select Nudge handles and enable it.
In Accessibility, switch Nudge off and on. Check HyperOS setup if it disconnects again.
Request the phone volume popup without changing volume.
Request sent. Check whether the volume popup appeared.
You confirmed that the volume popup appeared.
The volume popup did not appear. Device compatibility needs investigation.
The volume request failed. Check Accessibility and try again.
An invisible touch area still receives touches. Keep it narrow to reduce interference with other controls.
The master switch must also be on.
Remove this handle. Keep all panels.
No handles. Select Add handle to create one.
This touch area overlaps another enabled handle.
Use the position controls to move the handle. The phone guide passes touches through while you edit.
Connect Accessibility to show the guide on your phone.
The phone guide follows the selected orientation. A landscape bottom handle appears on the left when the phone is upright.
Allow this handle when the phone is sideways.
Keep separate landscape settings. Turning this off retains those values.
Editing shared settings. Bottom remains at the bottom after rotation.
Show the handle in previews and during use.
Enable Make handle visible to edit appearance. Saved values are retained.
Thickness uses dp. A smaller touch area limits the visible thickness but keeps the saved value.
Swipe inward, then release. Further swipes cycle through assigned actions while a panel is open or before the timeout.
For Hold, keep the touch still. For Swipe and hold, stay beyond the selected distance. Select when the action runs.
Without an open panel, another swipe within this period advances the sequence. A panel keeps the sequence active until it closes.
Allow this handle on the awake lock screen. Apps and settings require the normal unlock step.
Handles stay hidden while the screen is off. After reboot, unlock the phone once before use.
Hide this handle in selected apps. Exclusions do not apply on the lock screen.
Restore appearance, placement, and gestures. Keep the name, enable switch, and panels.
Place the panel beside the handle.
Back closes the panel. Handle gestures remain available.
Fixed panels do not scroll. Buttons beyond the limit remain saved.
All buttons remain available by scrolling. Use Test panel to check scrolling.
Buttons not shown: %1$d. Increase the limit or select Scrollable.
Screen limit: %1$d. Saved values are retained.
Preview buttons do not run actions. Test panel opens working controls.
The action failed. Check permissions and try again.
This app is unavailable. Edit the button to choose another app.
Allow Do Not Disturb access to use this sound control.
Do Not Disturb may remain on if another rule is active.
No static icons found in this pack.
Saved icon pack is unavailable. Original icons are shown.
Backups include handles, panels, gesture assignments, and hidden buttons. Install icon packs separately.
Copy handles and panels. New handles start off. Keep current shortcuts and global settings.
Replace all handles, panels, and global settings. Nudge will stay paused for review.
Configuration imported. Review the handles before enabling them.
The backup could not be read or written. Check the file and available storage.
The backup exceeds the 1 MiB limit.
This configuration needs a different Nudge version. Saved data has been kept.
The configuration is invalid. Saved data has been kept.
Settings could not be read. Saved data has been kept. Select Retry to try again.
Changes are visible but not saved. Check storage and select Retry.
Open Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps → Nudge handles. Enable the service.
If Android blocks Accessibility, open Nudge App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Return to Accessibility and enable Nudge.
Enable Nudge under Settings → Apps → Permissions → Background autostart. Some builds list Autostart under Apps or Security → Permissions.
Autostart is recommended on HyperOS. Nudge cannot verify this setting. Menu names vary by build.
Try App info → Battery saver → No restrictions. Keep current battery settings if Nudge stays connected.
Try Security → Settings → Boost speed → Lock apps → Nudge. Some builds also support locking Nudge in Recents.
If the service disconnects, copy diagnostics before switching Nudge off and on in Accessibility. Force-stop or revoked permissions require manual recovery.
Handles work while the screen is awake. Nudge does not keep the phone awake. Check battery use after changing HyperOS restrictions.
Include published test versions when checking for updates.
Tap Check for updates to contact GitHub.
No matching release was found. Enable testing to include pre-releases.
You have the latest matching release: %1$s.
The update check failed. Check your connection or view releases on GitHub.
GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later or view releases.
GitHub blocked this check. Try again later or view releases.
Public Nudge releases could not be found on GitHub.
GitHub is unavailable. Try again later.
The release data could not be read. Try again later or view releases.
The response was too large. View releases on GitHub.
This version could not be compared. View releases on GitHub.
No APK is attached to this release. Open the release notes to check its files.
Download paused. Android will retry when the connection is available.
Download complete. Tap Install update to continue.
The download could not start. Check that Android Download Manager is enabled, or open the release notes.
The APK could not be saved. Check free storage, then retry.
The download failed. Check your connection, then retry.
The downloaded APK is missing. Download it again.
The file is not a readable APK. Download it again.
This APK is not a Nudge update. Open the release notes to check its files.
This APK does not match the selected release or has no newer version code.
The APK signing key does not match this installation. Open the release notes to check its files.
A release APK cannot update this debug app. Install the release APK from GitHub separately.
The download failed. Retry or open the release notes.
The selected download changed. Tap Install update again.
Allow Nudge under Install unknown apps, then tap Install update again.
The installer could not open. Try again or open the release notes.
Release APKs install separately from this debug app.
No browser is available to open this link.
Diagnostics copied. Add the HyperOS version and observed test results.
A handle or panel could not be shown. Re-enable Accessibility and check diagnostics.
Phone preview. Use Center along edge to move the handle.
Unavailable in the current screen state
Drag grips to set priority. The first handle receives touches where touch areas overlap.
Save these changes before you leave. Discard restores the saved settings.
Do Not Disturb access is allowed
Do Not Disturb access is needed
This phone does not expose the shortcut. Use the steps below.
Positive X moves right. Positive Y moves up. Screen edges can limit movement.
Show the native volume popup when this button changes volume.
Put icons inside a shape. Each button can override this setting.
Use a neutral background. Active sound controls use blue.
Keep built-in icons readable. App and pack icons keep their colors.
Choose how panels open and close. Slide direction follows the handle edge.
Choose how the brightness popup opens and closes. Slides follow the popup side.
Create panels and assign them to handle gestures.
No panels yet. Select Add panel to create one.
Remove this panel and clear its gesture links. Keep the volume part of combined assignments.
Open the native system panel. Some phones use one panel for both actions.
Cannot open the system panel on this screen.
Change brightness by five percent. This turns off automatic brightness.
Maximum brightness is active at the manual maximum. Tap again to restore brightness. Other manual changes discard previous brightness.
Restore the previous level and automatic mode. Maximum brightness and this action\'s own limit are unavailable.
Jump to touch sets brightness at the touch position. Slide to adjust changes the current level with your drag distance.
Use this level when Use previous brightness is off or the previous level is unavailable. This level uses manual brightness.
Allow Modify system settings. Then tap the brightness button again.
Brightness is already at this limit.
Cannot change brightness. Check Modify system settings and try again.
Stop gestures. Keep saved Enable switches.
Keep gestures and saved visibility settings.
Pause the selected enabled handles. Tap again to resume. Keep the saved Enable switches. Resume all from the Handles tab.
No enabled handles match. This handle and Other handles need a handle that opens the panel.
Cannot take a screenshot. Check the current screen and try again.
Cannot open Input Method. Try again.
Create a panel in the Panels tab to assign it here.
This choice affects the preview only. During use, the handle that opens the panel sets its placement.
Close the panel after no touch input. Reset the swipe sequence.
The timer restarts when you open or touch the panel. It pauses while you touch the panel.
Pass touch through and keep open
Show the native volume popup. Select No action for the popup alone.
This button keeps its grid space and performs no action.
Use the longer screen edge as the maximum. The saved length stays unchanged when space is limited.
Saved length: %1$d dp. Available length: %2$d dp.
The first gesture reveals the handle. The next gesture runs its action. The hidden touch area still receives touches.
Full screen uses hidden status bars. If the phone does not report visibility, the handle keeps its normal behavior.
Open the brightness slider with this gesture. You can also show the volume popup.
Drag to change brightness. This turns off automatic brightness.
These starting dimensions approximate the volume popup. Adjust them to match your phone.
Show a non-interactive preview while Home is open. The preview does not change brightness.
Select the side used by your phone. Android does not report the volume popup position.
Allow Modify system settings to change brightness. Showing a preview does not need this access.
Create a shortcut for a button action. Your launcher asks you to confirm. Accessibility must stay connected.
Confirm the shortcut in your launcher.
Your launcher does not support adding shortcuts. You can select another launcher.
Could not add the shortcut. Open Home and try again.
This shortcut is unavailable. Check its action in Nudge.
Connect Nudge in Accessibility to use this shortcut.
Select the handle used by Current handle or Other handles.
Remove this shortcut from Nudge? Remove its icon from your Home screen separately.
Replace also imports brightness slider settings and shortcut definitions. It does not add icons to your Home screen.
Turn automatic brightness on or off. The phone controls brightness when this is on.
Turn this off to fill the slider width without an outer background.
Show the Automatic brightness button below the slider.
Vibrate once when this gesture runs. Available strength depends on your phone.
Calibrate if Return brightness does not match your phone’s brightness slider.
Brightness uses your saved calibration. Calibration stays on this device.
Turn off automatic brightness. Open Control center and set its brightness slider to the requested position. Return here and select Capture.
Set the native brightness slider to %1$d%%.
Cannot save this sample. Turn off automatic brightness. Each sample must be higher than the previous sample.
Measure from the starting point. Hold beyond the distance. Moving back below the distance restarts the hold.
Hide or show the selected enabled handles. Keep their gestures and saved appearance. Visibility changes stay saved.
Toggle each group independently. Paused handles resume. Hidden handles show. Visibility stays saved. Pauses reset when the service restarts.
